C25190.summary: UNI-ROYAL's exact-part-linked thick-film datasheet (V.3, 2019-02-12, section 11) specifies ±100 ppm/°C for 0603 resistors above 10 Ω. This 27 Ω part is in that range. The catalog attribute is correct; the description's ±200 ppm/°C has been corrected here. The raw supplier record is preserved.

C78395.summary: Brightking's exact-part-linked P6SMB table gives 1,000 µA at 5.8 V and 25 °C, then requires doubling IR for bidirectional types with VRWM ≤10 V. The applicable limit is therefore 2,000 µA (2 mA), not the old 1 µA description or the newer 1 mA attribute without its footnote. The original supplier values are retained in the source snapshot.

source.label: Brightking P6SMB datasheet linked from C78395

C42413902.summary: Hongjiacheng SM Series Rev. 2.1 shows two unidirectional protection lines at pins 1 and 2 with their common anode at pin 3. The SM08 row specifies 8.5 V minimum breakdown at 1 mA, 13.4 V maximum clamping at 1 A, and 24 V maximum at 15 A (8/20 µs). The two clamp figures are different test currents, not conflicting limits. The two-channel label is manufacturer-confirmed.

source.label: Hongjiacheng SM Series datasheet linked from C42413902

C7420375.summary: The exact SM712 sheet confirms 300 W and 12 A for an 8/20 µs waveform. It protects two asymmetric −7 V/+12 V lines; the two standoff values refer to opposite directions, not a symmetric 7 V clamp.

source.label: SM712 manufacturer datasheet linked from C7420375

C19077496.summary: The exact-part-linked SMF table gives SMF3.3CA breakdown 5.2–6.5 V at 10 mA and 8.8 V maximum clamping at 22.7 A, 10/1000 µs. Its 500 µA table leakage limit is doubled by note 3 for bidirectional parts at ≤10 V standoff: use 1 mA maximum at 3.3 V and 25 °C. The older description has been corrected; original values are retained.

source.label: SMF3.3CA manufacturer datasheet linked from C19077496

C19077522.summary: The exact-part-linked SMAJ table gives SMAJ3.3CA breakdown 5.2–6 V at 10 mA. Its 800 µA table leakage limit is doubled by note 3 for bidirectional parts at ≤10 V standoff: use 1.6 mA maximum at 3.3 V and 25 °C. The catalog’s 6 V is the breakdown maximum, and its 800 µA scalar omits the footnote; the older 9 V/600 µA description is corrected too.

source.label: SMAJ3.3CA manufacturer datasheet linked from C19077522

C20615779.summary: The exact H5VN06B table specifies 15 pF typical and 22 pF maximum at 0 V and 1 MHz. The catalog change from 15 to 22 pF changed the reported statistic, not the device.

source.label: H5VN06B manufacturer datasheet linked from C20615779

C20615780.summary: The exact H5VU06B table gives 0.3 pF typical and 0.5 pF maximum at 0 V and 1 MHz. The newer 0.3 pF catalog scalar must not be treated as a maximum.

source.label: H5VU06B manufacturer datasheet linked from C20615780

C20615782.summary: The exact H3V3U10B table gives 0.25 pF typical and 0.3 pF maximum at 0 V and 1 MHz. Preserve both conditions rather than interpreting the catalog change as a lower guaranteed maximum.

source.label: H3V3U10B manufacturer datasheet linked from C20615782

C20615800.summary: The exact H5VU25UC table distinguishes I/O-to-ground capacitance (0.8 pF maximum) from I/O-to-I/O capacitance (0.3 pF typical, 0.4 pF maximum), all at 0 V and 1 MHz. The old pair represented different pin pairs.

source.label: H5VU25UC manufacturer datasheet linked from C20615800

C20615809.summary: The exact H8VSD3B table specifies 13 V maximum clamping at 1 A and 25 V maximum at 20 A, both with an 8/20 µs pulse. These are different test-current limits.

source.label: H8VSD3B manufacturer datasheet linked from C20615809

attributes.Junction Capacitance: 0.6pF typ, 0.8pF max I/O–GND; 0.3pF typ, 0.4pF max I/O–I/O (0V, 1MHz)

C20615824.summary: The exact H5VUT2U table gives I/O-to-ground capacitance of 0.6 pF typical/0.8 pF maximum and I/O-to-I/O capacitance of 0.3 pF typical/0.4 pF maximum. The catalog 0.6 pF is a typical value.

source.label: H5VUT2U manufacturer datasheet linked from C20615824

C20617909.summary: The exact H3V3N10B table specifies 5 nA typical and 50 nA maximum leakage at VRWM = 3.3 V and 25 °C. The catalog change switched from maximum to typical; it did not establish a new 5 nA limit.

source.label: H3V3N10B manufacturer datasheet linked from C20617909

C20617916.summary: The exact H4V5HD3U table specifies 7 V maximum clamping at 20 A and 15 V maximum at 185 A with an 8/20 µs pulse. The old pair described two current conditions, not forward/reverse operation.

source.label: H4V5HD3U manufacturer datasheet linked from C20617916
